name: AI Agent Skills
summary: Curated library of agent skills plus a CLI and TUI to install them and build your own skill library.
description: A curated library of Agent Skills for AI coding agents, with an installer CLI and TUI. The bundled library ships 115 cataloged skills (17 house copies, 98 cataloged upstream) arranged in shelves — frontend, backend, mobile, workflow, agent engineering, marketing — and smaller collections. It installs to ~/.claude/skills or .agents/skills and works with any Agent Skills-compatible agent; managed workspaces let you add, catalog, vendor and curate your own picks.
contains: 115 cataloged skills (17 house copies, 98 cataloged upstream)
shelves: frontend 10, backend 5, mobile 24, workflow 12, agent engineering 14, marketing 76
collections: my-picks, build-apps, swift-agent-skills, build-systems, test-and-debug, docs-and-research, mktg
CLI: list, browse, install, add, catalog, vendor, curate, sync
legacy --agent targets: claude, cursor, codex, amp, vscode, copilot, gemini, goose, opencode, letta, kilocode
